'''Ceramasteel''' was a hard metal compound used to build an [[Underwater Zeta Zero Nine base|underwater base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zeta Zero Nine]]. Although able to withstand the pressures of deep water, it was unable to stand up to a barrage of a multiple [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]], which compromised the structure of the base, causing it to explode.<ref name="DH">{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}}</ref>
